provenance.both: radius: assumed: 1 mm (2 mm particles); same size so the two compare directly
provenance.both: step: assumed: clean particle, surface gas switched at t = 0 to the column feed (y_A 0.30, 4.2 bar)
provenance.equilibrium: pore diffusivity: assumed: D_p 1.7e-6 m^2/s for A and B (Bosanquet of Knudsen in ~0.1 um pores and molecular diffusion at ~4 bar, tortuosity 3); equal because the generic species have equal molar mass
provenance.equilibrium: crystal LDF: assumed: 100 /s, fast enough that the crystals are nearly at local equilibrium
provenance.kinetic: isotherm: assumed: b_A = b_B = 0.25 /bar, q_s 3 mol/kg (equilibrium selectivity 1)
provenance.kinetic: diffusivities: assumed: Đ_A/R^2 = 1e-2 /s, Đ_B/R^2 = 1e-4 /s (ratio 100; CMS O2/N2 is ~30-100)
